name: PHARMING GRP  EO-,01
summary: Pharming Group N.V. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing innovative protein replacement therapies and precision medicines for the treatment of rare diseases and immune disorders. The company's lead product is Ruconest, a recombinant human C1 esterase inhibitor for the treatment of hereditary angioedema. Pharming Group is headquartered in Leiden, Netherlands.
